mathematical_scope: Complex numerical sanity audit of one seeded Haar-augmented mixer: dense unitarity 2-norm defect and twelve balanced cuts, one fixed half-cut and eleven random cuts. The source explicitly says not an all-cut certificate.
input_and_guard_coverage: No n domain/precision guard and no assert acceptance checks. It counts singular values >=1/64 with no tolerance margin, reports required_floor_fraction=N/512 as a float but never compares observed minimum to it. NumPy/backend behavior is unpinned.
cost_and_scaling: Dense N² matrix and Gram, spectral norm and 12 SVDs give O(N³) work and O(N²) storage; repeated for N32,64,128 by main. Sampling does not cover the exponentially many balanced cuts.
test_evidence: This file has no tests or pass condition. Output labels are statistics. Related phase13 tests check norms/round trips rather than exhausting cuts. Not executed.
dependency_identity: haar_adapter hash-only candidate c73970… and NumPy unpinned. Its local haar_adapter in turn needs phase12 sibling imports.

findings.finding: The returned required_floor_fraction is not enforced and singular-value threshold has no numerical margin. Successful execution cannot be counted as passing the stated cut target.
The sampled nature is clearly disclosed and must be retained in summaries.

acceptance_boundary: Accept as intended finite numerical diagnostics. No theorem-wide all-cut, robustness or passing-run claim follows.
